title: Backlog
description: Open work not parked in Maybe Someday. Exists so every open issue carries a milestone: with more than one open milestone the issue metadata audit comments on each unmilestoned issue, and the tracker audit reports it as drift.

title: Maybe Someday
description: Parking lot for tickets that solve a problem nobody has hit yet (speed over robustness, Dan 2026-09-18). Pull one back by changing its milestone; the ticket reaper never closes anything parked here.
